paragraphs.text: BGC Business Government Contact International International Business Forum, December 21, at the Pullman Tbilisi Axis Towers. This is a key event in Georgia’s real estate and business tourism market. The forum will focus on the promotion and exhibition of strategically important business sectors that are of high investment interest for Israeli business tourism, including brokers, real estate agents and investors. The first part of the forum will be dedicated to the development and construction sector. The second part of the forum will present wellness resorts, medical tourism, hospitality and restaurant business tourism, as well as agro-, eco-, and wine tourism.

Organizers: "Israel Georgia Business House" and "Business Media Contact." These companies serve as guidebooks, an online marketplace, a sales agency, and a consulting service for the Georgian real estate market, offering full brokerage, legal, and banking support for property and business registration, account opening, transferring large investment sums from foreign banks, obtaining preferential mortgage loans from banks, managing individual budget investment portfolios and businesses, generating a stable income, and organizing outbound business tourism tours for detailed market research.

Gala dinner with Georgian flavor and Award Ceremony for leading construction and real estate development companies in Georgia and real estate companies operating both in the Georgian and international markets, representatives of business tourism, as well as government projects promoting the development of international trade relations and the business climate of Georgia, contributing to the attraction of international investment.

The forum will bring together leading experts, developers, investors, real estate professionals, investment brokers, investment funds and government investment proposals, tour operators of business and corporate tourism from Georgia, Israel, Europe, the UAE, America and the CIS.

Analysis of the hottest topics in the primary and secondary real estate market in all regions of Georgia: (from international brand hotels, apart-hotels, luxury cottage villages and downtowns, villas and office premises and all areas of business tourism. Study of market trends and sales tools, an overview of the rapid growth of the Georgian market and how to become a part of it, as the Georgian market is rapidly developing technologically in all directions and is becoming a point of attraction for international investors and investment brokers.

You will be able to run a business, make remote transactions, and earn money from anywhere in the world. You will learn how to quickly enter a market where demand outstrips supply and start earning income from your investments in the first month.

The forum will provide first-hand presentations of new, current, and future projects from leading developers, with high potential for annual price growth: (at exclusively discounted prices for future partners, forum participants, with a 30% discount with a minimum 15% annual profit and preferential terms for internal interest-free installments, beneficial for creating profitable investment portfolios and organizing business brokerage tours of the best new buildings in Georgia).
Panel discussions and new approaches to working with primary and secondary real estate.

Welcome Party, Networking, Workshop, B2B and B2C meetings, company exhibition and real estate fair will help expand business ties with business partners and start earning money on Georgian and international real estate, business tourism from anywhere in the world, with full legal, audit, banking, tourist support, transport and language services.
Closing of the meeting with investors and developers in an informal setting.

Presentations of new leading projects by developers and builders, direct communication with company owners, without intermediaries, sales managers, or realtors. Travel agencies will be provided with a full package of business tourism services across all business areas in three languages (Russian, English, and Hebrew).

Detailed analysis of the Georgian market and price growth trends for 2026-2030, which directly depends on the largest investment in Georgia by the UAE company EMAAR and the construction of the EAGLE HILLS hotel chain in Tbilisi and on the Georgian coast.

Select investment types and strategies: mortgages or internal installments with subsequent management of investment properties, obtaining investment profits and a stable income from investments, thanks to proper operations in the sales and rental markets.
Special offers from leading Georgian banks for mortgage loans at favorable interest rates and payment terms.

Legal assistance in opening bank accounts and transferring large investment sums from foreign banks. We ensure free capital circulation, the absence of currency controls and restrictions on the input and output of resources.
Full support during registration and opening of companies in Georgia and property registration at every stage of the transaction, assistance with residence permit included.

Forum guests will receive exclusive discounts from leading international brand hotels. Future partners and forum guests will be provided with prime locations for company banners and prime time to present their businesses and participate in panel discussions.

"Israel Georgia Business House" cooperates with global hotel brands and assists in negotiations with their representatives and entry into the Georgian market. "Israel Georgia Business House" also works with companies managing international brand hotel complexes on the global market.

State patronage and support from government agencies in obtaining rights to participate in state tenders for the purchase of real estate for foreign investors. The best offers for land plots and state-approved projects will be presented.
We select the best insurance offers from leading insurance companies and complete contracts in 3 days with our professional support.

We consult on business and investment matters. We provide legal support for preparing tax returns that take into account low VAT and income taxes on dividends and capital gains, in accordance with the latest Georgian legislation.

Forum participants and future partners will be offered brokered outbound tours to Tbilisi, Kakheti, and the Adjara coastline in Batumi, as well as exclusive offers for services and partnerships with Georgian medical tourism providers, including aesthetic and plastic surgery clinics, hair transplant clinics, reproductive medicine clinics, and dental clinics. Exclusive prices will be offered by leading Georgian restaurants, chateaux, wineries, and wine tourism providers offering national culinary master classes and wine tastings. Exclusive offers from prestigious resorts, hotels, wellness and resort facilities will also be presented. The forum will feature offers from travel companies on a variety of tourist routes throughout Georgia's regions, as well as outbound tours of real estate properties.

If you want to invest reliably and earn a stable income, welcome to explore the Georgian market! The forum will bring together future partners and provide a catalog of leading projects that generate a stable annual income from investments located anywhere in the world.
ISRAEL GEORGIA BUSINESS FORUM
The forum's ideological support is provided by the forum's nominees and future partners: leading investment business and government projects.
